content:
maria: FYI i opened a docs PR to clarify what we mean by 'throughput' on model cards and to add an example MLflow benchmark job. also fixes an SDK snippet that uses the old client.generate call. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

maria: Problem: some cards say 'tokens/sec per GPU' and others say 'tokens/sec' (ambiguous). users have been confused whether values are per-replica or per-device. also missing sequence-length and batch-size in many entries.

daniel: can you list which model cards you changed? curious about quantized variants — do we need special notes for cpu fallback?

maria: changed orion-8b, zephyr-mini-4b, aurora-7b. added a short compatibility note for quantized CPU fallback and a pointer to runtime compat matrix.

maria: included an MLflow snippet for reproducible bench runs (artifact links to plots). snippet:```python
# run a simple throughput job and log to mlflow
from mlflow import log_metric, set_experiment
set_experiment('model-bench')
# pseudocode: run 200 iters, seq=512, batch=8, measure tokens/s
# log metrics: tokens_per_sec, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms
```

alex: I'll update the SDK example to use `client.text.generate` and include streaming example. do we want to keep a note about the legacy `client.generate` for migrations? :thinking_face:

sophie: @alex keep both. put legacy snippet under a 'Migration' collapsible with a deprecation note and link to the SDK changelog. also we need 3 redirects: old-snippet -> new-snippet, old-card-link -> new-card-url, and benchmarks index anchor. i'll create the redirect PR after these changes. :memo:

docs-bot: docs-build CI passed for PR #4321 — link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234 (artifact: docs/site/html) :white_check_mark:

jen: quick question: where should we surface the benchmark numbers? full tables in a dedicated benchmarks page and a short summary in the model card?

maria: short summary in the card (p50, p95, tokens/sec) + link to the detailed MLflow run/artifacts where plots and raw numbers live. that keeps cards readable.

daniel: SG. i'll add a tiny table row clarifying sequence length and batch size for each number (e.g., seq=512, batch=8). also adding a 'measured on' column (GPU type + quant config).

alex: i'll push an SDK PR after lunch and include the new snippet and a small note about tokenizer prebatching. assigning reviews to @maria and @sophie. :rocket:

sophie: lgtm. i'll review and also validate the redirect paths.

maria: tagging @noah from eng-ml for perf signoff on the numbers before we publish.

noah: happy to review perf numbers — ping me when the MLflow artifact link is in the PR.

maria: PR link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — contains card copy, mlflow example, SDK snippet update, and a few tiny link fixes. requesting reviews today so we can ship these clarifications with the upcoming release.

alex: posted a small preview of the new SDK example in the PR comments. will update after reviews. :thumbsup:

sophie: i filed the follow-up issue about adding a benchmark checklist to the card template: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/987

maria: thanks everyone. next steps: daniel updates table rows, alex sends SDK PR, sophie adds redirects, noah gives perf signoff. aiming to merge by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
